Lyrics, aligned
to your track.

en.settings.title: Alignment Provider
en.settings.subtitle: Gemini transport and local credentials
en.settings.languageHint: Applies immediately. Saved with local provider settings.
en.settings.keysNote: Keys are saved as plain text in an owner-only local configuration file (0600). CueWeave does not access Keychain or write keys into project files.
en.source.help.fixed: Create a new project to change the original NCM information source.
en.source.help.replace: Replacing the target invalidates Gemini and Final timing while preserving lyrics and metadata draft.
en.source.timingIsolationBody: Source lyric timestamps are destroyed before project creation. Only the selected Gemini provider or manual timing can place lyrics on this target audio.
en.meta.title: TITLE
en.meta.coverHint: PNG or JPEG · embedded at export
en.lyrics.emptyDetail: Resolve by NetEase musicId, add lines by hand, or import plain text, LRC or YRC. Every source timestamp will be removed.
en.lyrics.insertSubtitle: Insert plain text between existing lines. Timing is stripped; existing IDs stay stable.
en.lyrics.name: Name
en.lyrics.creditsNote: Credits live on the timeline and are never sent to Gemini as sung lyrics.
en.lyrics.translationHint: Gemini, text import, and line editing live on the Translation page. This page keeps original lyric text only.
en.lyrics.importSubtitle: LRC and YRC timing will be discarded
en.lyrics.previewSubtitle: Exactly the lyric text sent with the target MP3
en.translation.emptyDetail: Import or fetch lyrics first. Translation is bound to those line IDs.
en.translation.geminiHint: Uses the current alignment provider, model, and API key. The request is text-only — no target audio is uploaded.
en.translation.coverageHint: Import a plain-text or LRC translation, one line per original lyric. Extra lines are ignored; shorter imports leave the rest unchanged.
en.translation.importSubtitle: LRC timing is stripped · originals are not replaced
en.timeline.title: Timeline
en.align.restoreHelp: Replace every Final value with the stored Gemini baseline. Undo with ⌘Z.
en.align.emptyDetail: Fetch or import lyrics before opening the timeline.
en.credit.introTooShort: Intro is too short for these credit cues. Merge them or keep them overlapping at 0:00.
en.inspect.emptyDetail: Choose a lyric segment to inspect its timing.
en.inspect.hint: Press Enter to select the playing lyric, or Tab for the next one.
en.inspect.hint.win: Press Enter to select the lyric at the playhead.
en.inspect.translationHint: Translation is edited on the Translation page.
en.playback.speedHelp: Playback speed with pitch preservation. = faster, − slower
en.follow.help: Keep the playback position centered while audio is playing
en.next.help: Keep the selected lyric on the next line after the playhead (shortcut N). Turns off if you click a lyric or use Return, ↑↓, or ⇧Tab
en.next.help.win: Keep selection on the lyric after the playhead (N)
en.hotkey.clickAway: Click empty space to leave a text field
en.hotkey.windowsHint: Space play; Return select playing lyric; Tab next lyric; N keep next lyric selected; arrows seek/navigate; Esc clear A-B; =/− rate; Ctrl+=/− zoom.
en.row.hint: Select this lyric. Return, Tab, and Shift-Tab use the same selection.
en.export.title: Final Export
en.export.outputHint: Export Final writes a new MP3. Save Cue Sheet writes the player-agnostic JSON later plugins will consume.
en.export.outputHint.win: Export Final writes a new MP3 without re-encoding. Save Cue Sheet writes player-agnostic JSON later plugins consume.
en.export.overwriteExistingHint: Replace the chosen MP3 and matching LRC if they already exist. The target audio is never overwritten.
en.export.overwriteConfirmMessage: “{0}” already exists. Replace it and any matching LRC?
en.export.adaptersNote: Built-in adapters: LRC sidecar, USLT/SYLT tags. Bilingual writes a second LRC line at the same timestamp, and a second USLT/SYLT frame (ISO-639-2 zho). Additional players plug into the Cue Sheet JSON, not the project file.
